messages:
jess: Heads up — Lucent EAP kickoff. NDA signed, lab access starts Mon. Need a bench plan, telemetry schema, and a 1-week feedback loop cadence. Who can own what? :wave:

mike: I can own the bench plan + perf targets. Will pair with Lin on telemetry.

lin_bench: happy to help. Quick q — do we prioritize throughput scenarios or chat tail latency first?

jess: Prioritize throughput at 512 seq and 2k context, secondary is tail latency for chat and cold-start behavior (cache warmup).

sara_lucent: From Lucent's side: please include microbench (kernel-level) + LLM throughput across batch sizes 1/8/32. We also need a failure/runbook for thermal throttling and OOM.

mike: Got it. Draft perf test plan by Wed EOD. We'll use the standard harness and include env matrix. Example run command we’ll use:
```
./run_bench --model redwood-base-3b --ctx 2048 --batch 8 --steps 100
```

lin_bench: Telemetry schema proposal: token_latency_ms, p95/p99, gpu_util_pct, host_mem_mb, kv_cache_hit_rate, model_variant, batch_size. I'll put together JSON schema and example logs.

tony_legal: Confirmed NDA allows aggregated telemetry sharing. Anything identifiable (customer prompts / test audio) must be redacted. I'll drop a 1-pager on allowed fields.

jess: Great. We also need an automated feedback loop: daily syncs while active plus a Friday wrap with a short findings doc. Who can host daily?

sara_lucent: I can host daily 30m standups at 11am PT starting Monday. Will create recurring invite.

mike: Owners summary: Bench plan — @mike; Telemetry schema — @lin_bench; Runbook/failure modes — @sara_lucent; Legal guidance/redaction — @tony_legal. I'll open a perf-config PR against integrations/lucent.

deploy-bot: Deployed bench-harness v2.3 to lucent-lab cluster. Logs and artifacts: https://ci.redwood/integration/lucent/1725123456

jess: Perfect. Targets: initial runs by Thu, preliminary feedback doc by Fri. Please tag me on PRs and drop the telemetry schema in this thread. :thumbsup:
